name: Headache / Migraine
causes: Stress, lack of sleep, dehydration, long screen time, skipped meals, bright light or loud noise. Migraines can also be triggered by hormones and certain foods.
avoid: Too much tea/coffee, cheese, chocolate, processed food, bright light, going hungry, staying up late.
eat: Water, coconut water, banana, almonds, ginger-turmeric tea, regular meals.
treat: Rest in a quiet, dark room, apply a cold or warm compress, stay hydrated and sleep 7–8 hours.
lifestyle: Keep a fixed sleep time, never skip meals, drink water through the day, take screen breaks every 30 minutes and note your triggers in a diary.

name: Fever
causes: Viral or bacterial infection, flu, typhoid, dengue/malaria in season, throat or urinary infection.
avoid: Cold or oily food, overexertion, heavy blankets, going without fluids.
eat: Khichdi, porridge, soups, coconut water, ORS, seasonal fruits and plenty of water.
treat: Rest, wear light clothes, sponge with lukewarm water. See a doctor if fever lasts more than 3 days or goes above 103°F.
lifestyle: Wash hands often, keep your home ventilated, avoid mosquito bites (use nets) and drink only clean, boiled or filtered water.

name: Cough
causes: Cold or flu, dust or smoke allergy, asthma, acid reflux, infection.
avoid: Cold water, ice cream, fried food, smoke, dust.
eat: Honey with ginger, tulsi tea, turmeric milk, warm water, soups.
treat: Gargle with warm water, steam inhalation, honey. See a doctor if the cough lasts over 2 weeks or you cough up blood.
medicine: No strong medicine; cough syrup only on a doctor’s advice
lifestyle: Avoid smoke and dust (wear a mask), stay away from smokers, keep your room clean and avoid cold drinks.

name: Common Cold
causes: Virus (rhinovirus), change of season, spread of infection in crowds, low immunity.
avoid: Cold drinks, direct AC air, curd at night.
eat: Vitamin C (lemon, amla, orange), warm soup, herbal kadha, turmeric milk.
treat: Steam inhalation, saline nasal rinse, rest and hand washing. It usually clears in 5–7 days.
lifestyle: Sleep well, exercise regularly, get sunlight for vitamin D, wash hands often and avoid crowded places during flu season.

name: Sore Throat
causes: Viral infection, strep bacteria, cold food, acid reflux, too much talking.
avoid: Cold, sour or fried food, cold drinks, smoke.
eat: Warm water, honey-ginger, turmeric milk, soups, soft food.
treat: Gargle with warm salt water 3–4 times a day, rest, lozenges. See a doctor if it lasts over 5 days or swallowing is difficult.
lifestyle: Avoid shouting or loud talking, quit smoking, drink warm fluids and avoid sudden cold-hot changes.

name: Acidity
causes: Spicy or oily food, skipped meals, tea/coffee, stress, lying down right after eating.
avoid: Spicy and fried food, tea, coffee, cold drinks, late-night meals.
eat: Banana, cold milk, fennel seeds, curd or buttermilk, oatmeal, coconut water.
treat: Eat small meals, wait 2–3 hours before lying down, chew fennel seeds, sleep with your head raised.
lifestyle: Eat at fixed times, have dinner at least 2–3 hours before sleep, avoid overeating and keep your weight healthy.

name: Constipation
causes: Low fibre, low water intake, lack of movement, stress, side effects of medicines.
avoid: Refined flour (maida), junk food, too much tea, too much cheese.
eat: Fibre: vegetables, oats, papaya, apple, lentils with husk, 2.5–3 litres of water.
treat: Warm lemon water in the morning, 30 minutes of walking daily, fixed toilet time. See a doctor if it lasts over a week.
lifestyle: Add fibre to every meal, drink enough water, walk daily and do not ignore the urge to go to the toilet.

name: Diarrhoea
causes: Contaminated food or water, stomach infection, food poisoning, some medicines.
avoid: Fried and spicy food, dairy, outside food, raw salad.
eat: ORS, curd rice, banana, khichdi, salted-sweet lemon water, coconut water.
treat: Prevent dehydration by sipping ORS often. See a doctor right away if there is blood, high fever, or it lasts over 2 days.
lifestyle: Wash hands before eating, avoid street food and unclean water, store food properly and eat fresh meals.

name: Stomach Pain
causes: Gas, acidity, constipation, infection, period cramps, food intolerance, sometimes ulcer or stones.
avoid: Fried and spicy food, cold drinks, too much tea, outside food.
eat: Light food: khichdi, curd, banana, cumin or carom seed water, mint tea.
treat: Warm compress on the belly, rest, carom seeds with black salt. See a doctor for severe or persistent pain, vomiting or fever.
medicine: Only after a doctor’s advice (like Hyoscine/Drotaverine)
lifestyle: Eat slowly in small portions, avoid overeating, manage stress and avoid outside oily food.

name: Toothache
causes: Cavity, gum infection, broken tooth, sensitivity, wisdom tooth.
avoid: Too much sugar, very hot or cold items, sticky food.
eat: Soft food, curd, porridge, water. Brush twice a day.
treat: Rinse with salt water, clove oil on cotton, cold compress. Do see a dentist, as tooth pain does not go away on its own.
medicine: Paracetamol 500 mg (until you see a dentist)
lifestyle: Brush twice daily, floss, rinse after meals, cut down sugar and visit a dentist every 6 months.

name: Skin Itching
causes: Dry skin, allergy, fungal infection, sweat, reaction to clothes or soap, scabies.
avoid: Harsh soaps, hot showers, scratching, tight synthetic clothes.
eat: Plenty of water, omega-3 (walnuts, flaxseed), fruits and vegetables.
treat: Moisturiser, calamine lotion, loose cotton clothes, good hygiene. See a doctor if rash appears or it lasts over a week.
lifestyle: Use mild soap, moisturise daily after bathing, wash clothes with gentle detergent and wear cotton.

name: Acne
causes: Hormonal changes, oily skin, clogged pores, stress, dirty hands or pillow covers, some cosmetics.
avoid: Popping pimples, oily creams or makeup, too much sugar and junk food, dairy for some people.
eat: Water, vegetables, fruits, low-sugar food, zinc (pumpkin seeds).
treat: Gentle face wash twice a day, non-comedogenic moisturiser, sunscreen, avoid touching your face. See a dermatologist if severe.
lifestyle: Wash pillow covers weekly, keep hair off your face, sleep well and reduce stress and sugar.

name: Hair Fall
causes: Lack of iron, protein or vitamin D, stress, hormonal changes (thyroid, PCOS), dandruff, heat styling.
avoid: Crash diets, very hot water, tight hairstyles, harsh chemical products.
eat: Eggs, lentils, paneer, spinach, chickpeas, walnuts, amla.
treat: Gentle oil massage, mild shampoo, 7–8 hours of sleep. For heavy hair fall, get blood tests (iron, thyroid, vitamin D).
medicine: No emergency medicine; treatment only through a dermatologist
lifestyle: Eat enough protein and iron, avoid heat styling, do not tie hair tightly and manage stress.

name: Back Pain
causes: Poor posture, long sitting hours, weak muscles, lifting heavy objects, disc problems.
avoid: Slouching, heavy lifting, sitting too long, very soft mattress.
eat: Calcium and vitamin D (milk, curd, sunlight), protein, turmeric milk.
treat: Warm compress, gentle stretching, stand up every 30–40 minutes, keep your back straight. See a doctor right away if there is leg numbness or weakness.
lifestyle: Fix your sitting posture, use a chair with back support, exercise to strengthen your core and lift with your knees, not your back.

name: Joint Pain
causes: Arthritis, high uric acid, low vitamin D or calcium, injury, excess weight, ageing.
avoid: Weight gain, too much red meat, sugar, sitting too long.
eat: Milk, curd, turmeric, fenugreek, walnuts, spinach, omega-3, sunlight.
treat: Gentle exercise or yoga, warm compress, weight control. See a doctor if there is swelling, redness or fever.
lifestyle: Stay active with low-impact exercise (walking, swimming, yoga), keep a healthy weight and get morning sunlight.

name: Fatigue
causes: Poor sleep, anaemia, low vitamin B12 or D, thyroid issues, stress, poor diet or hydration, diabetes.
avoid: Staying up late, too much caffeine, junk food, skipping breakfast.
eat: Iron-rich food (spinach, beetroot, jaggery and chickpeas), fruits, bananas, dry fruits, water.
treat: Keep a fixed sleep schedule, get sunlight, walk daily. Get blood tests done if it lasts over 2 weeks.
medicine: No emergency medicine; get tested first
lifestyle: Keep a regular routine, eat balanced meals, drink water, exercise lightly daily and cut down caffeine.

name: Sleep Problems
causes: Stress, phone use at night, caffeine, irregular timings, anxiety, noise or light.
avoid: Phone before bed, tea/coffee in the evening, heavy dinner.
eat: Warm milk, banana, almonds, chamomile tea. Keep dinner light.
treat: Sleep and wake at the same time daily, keep the room dark and cool, switch off screens an hour before bed, practise deep breathing.
medicine: None; never take sleeping pills without a doctor
lifestyle: Follow a fixed bedtime routine, exercise in the day, avoid naps late in the afternoon and keep your phone away from the bed.

name: Stress
causes: Study or work pressure, relationships, money worries, lack of sleep, loneliness.
avoid: Too much caffeine, intoxicants, overthinking alone, excess social media.
eat: Fruits, dry fruits, green tea, omega-3 foods, regular meals.
treat: Deep breathing, meditation, walks, talking to friends or family, hobbies. See a counsellor or doctor if sadness or anxiety persists.
medicine: None; medicines only on a doctor’s advice
lifestyle: Plan your day, take breaks, exercise, spend time with loved ones and limit news and social media.

name: Allergy
causes: Immune reaction to dust, pollen, pet hair, certain foods, medicines or cosmetics.
avoid: Your triggers, dust, smoke, sudden hot-cold changes.
eat: Vitamin C, turmeric, ginger, vegetables. Avoid trigger foods.
treat: Identify and avoid triggers, keep your home clean, steam inhalation. Go to a hospital immediately if breathing is difficult or the face or lips swell.
lifestyle: Wash bedding weekly in hot water, keep windows closed in pollen season and shower after being outdoors.

name: PCOD / PCOS
causes: Hormonal imbalance, insulin resistance, genetics, stress, low activity, weight gain.
avoid: Refined flour, sugar, cold drinks, packaged or junk food, crash diets.
eat: Fibre and protein: vegetables, lentils, eggs, oats, whole grains, nuts, cinnamon, fenugreek.
treat: 30–45 minutes of exercise or yoga daily, weight control, better sleep and less stress. Treatment and tests by a gynaecologist are essential.
medicine: No emergency medicine; only as advised by a gynaecologist
lifestyle: Keep a regular sleep and meal routine, exercise most days, aim for a healthy weight and get regular check-ups.

name: Gas & Bloating
causes: Swallowing air, eating too fast, beans, cabbage and fizzy drinks, constipation, food intolerance.
avoid: Fizzy drinks, chewing gum, too many beans, overeating, talking while eating.
eat: Ginger tea, fennel seeds, carom seeds, peppermint tea, curd, papaya.
treat: Walk gently after meals, drink warm water, massage the belly clockwise, try a knee-to-chest stretch.
lifestyle: Eat slowly with your mouth closed, walk after meals and avoid carbonated drinks.

name: Nausea / Vomiting
causes: Stomach infection, food poisoning, acidity, migraine, motion, pregnancy, strong smells.
avoid: Oily, spicy and heavy food, strong smells, lying flat after eating.
eat: Small sips of water or ORS, ginger tea, toast, banana, plain rice.
treat: Sip fluids slowly, rest sitting up, try ginger or lemon. See a doctor if vomiting lasts over 24 hours, has blood, or you cannot keep water down.
medicine: ORS in small sips (anti-vomiting medicine only through a doctor)
lifestyle: Eat small frequent meals, avoid strong smells and keep food fresh and hygienic.

name: Dehydration
causes: Not drinking enough water, heat, sweating, fever, diarrhoea, vomiting.
avoid: Too much tea, coffee, soda and alcohol; staying long in the sun.
eat: Water, ORS, coconut water, buttermilk, lemon water, watermelon, cucumber.
treat: Drink fluids regularly and rest in shade. Seek urgent care for confusion, no urine for 8 hours or fainting.
lifestyle: Carry a water bottle, drink before you feel thirsty and check urine colour (pale yellow is good).

name: Dandruff
causes: Dry scalp, yeast on the scalp, oily scalp, infrequent washing, stress.
avoid: Sharing combs, very hot water on hair, heavy oils, scratching.
eat: Foods with zinc and omega-3 (nuts, seeds), vegetables, curd, plenty of water.
treat: Wash hair 2–3 times a week with anti-dandruff shampoo, massage the scalp and rinse well. See a dermatologist if severe or red.
lifestyle: Wash combs and pillow covers often, manage stress and avoid tight caps for long hours.

name: Dry Skin
causes: Dry weather, hot showers, harsh soaps, low water intake, ageing, eczema.
avoid: Hot water baths, strong soaps, scrubbing, alcohol-based products.
eat: Water, omega-3 foods, fruits, vegetables, nuts and healthy fats.
treat: Apply moisturiser right after bathing, use lukewarm water and a gentle cleanser. See a doctor if cracked or very itchy.
lifestyle: Bathe less often in winter, drink more water and use sunscreen daily.

name: Muscle Cramps
causes: Dehydration, low sodium, potassium or magnesium, overexertion, long sitting, tight muscles.
avoid: Sudden heavy exercise, dehydration, too much caffeine.
eat: Banana, coconut water, ORS, milk, nuts, leafy greens.
treat: Stretch and gently massage the muscle, apply a warm compress and drink fluids.
medicine: No medicine usually needed; ORS or electrolytes if you sweated a lot
lifestyle: Warm up before exercise, stay hydrated and stretch daily.

name: Neck Pain
causes: Poor posture, looking down at the phone, a bad pillow, stress, muscle strain.
avoid: Long phone or laptop use, heavy bag on one shoulder, sudden jerks.
eat: Water, calcium and vitamin D rich foods, turmeric milk.
treat: Warm compress, gentle neck stretches and a supportive pillow. See a doctor for arm numbness or pain after an injury.
lifestyle: Raise your screen to eye level, take breaks every 30 minutes and use a thin supportive pillow.

name: Eye Strain
causes: Long screen time, less blinking, poor lighting, uncorrected vision.
avoid: Reading in dim light, rubbing eyes, screens in the dark.
eat: Carrots, leafy greens, eggs, fish, citrus fruits, water.
treat: Follow the 20-20-20 rule: every 20 minutes look 20 feet away for 20 seconds. Blink often and adjust screen brightness.
lifestyle: Reduce screen time, keep the screen an arm’s length away and get your eyes tested yearly.

name: Red / Itchy Eyes
causes: Allergy, dust, conjunctivitis (infection), dryness, contact lenses, lack of sleep.
avoid: Rubbing eyes, makeup, contact lenses, sharing towels.
eat: Water and vitamin A rich food (carrot, spinach, papaya).
treat: Wash hands, use a cold compress and rinse with clean water. See a doctor if there is pus, pain, vision change or it lasts over 2 days.
medicine: Lubricating eye drops (antibiotic drops only through a doctor)
lifestyle: Do not share towels or makeup, wash your face daily and keep contact lenses clean.

name: Earache
causes: Ear infection, cold, water in the ear, wax, tooth or throat problems.
avoid: Putting buds or pins in the ear, water entering the ear, loud music.
eat: Warm fluids, soft light food, water.
treat: Warm compress on the outer ear, rest and keep the ear dry. See a doctor for discharge, fever or hearing loss.
lifestyle: Never put pins or buds in the ear, dry ears after bathing and keep headphone volume low.

name: Nosebleed
causes: Dry air, nose picking, cold, injury, allergy, high blood pressure.
avoid: Picking the nose, forceful blowing, hot dry rooms.
eat: Vitamin C and K foods (citrus, leafy greens) and water.
treat: Sit up, lean forward and pinch the soft part of the nose for 10 minutes. See a doctor if bleeding lasts over 20 minutes or follows an injury.
medicine: None needed; a saline nasal spray keeps the nose moist
lifestyle: Keep the air moist, trim your nails and avoid picking your nose.

name: Hiccups
causes: Eating fast, fizzy drinks, spicy food, sudden temperature change, excitement.
avoid: Eating too fast, carbonated drinks, overeating.
eat: Sip water slowly; a spoon of sugar or honey.
treat: Hold your breath for 10 seconds, sip cold water slowly or breathe into a paper bag. See a doctor if they last over 48 hours.
lifestyle: Eat slowly in small bites and avoid fizzy drinks.

name: Mouth Ulcers
causes: Cheek biting, stress, vitamin B12 or iron deficiency, spicy food, hormonal changes.
avoid: Spicy, salty and sour food, hard-bristled brushes.
eat: Curd, buttermilk, coconut water, banana and vitamin B rich food.
treat: Rinse with warm salt water, apply gel and drink cool fluids. See a doctor if an ulcer lasts over 2 weeks.
medicine: Choline salicylate or lidocaine mouth gel (like Zytee/Dologel)
lifestyle: Brush gently with a soft brush, manage stress and eat enough vitamins.

name: Bad Breath
causes: Poor oral hygiene, tongue coating, dry mouth, cavities, smoking, acidity, onion or garlic.
avoid: Smoking, tobacco, skipping brushing, too much onion or garlic.
eat: Water, crunchy fruits and vegetables, fennel seeds, cloves.
treat: Brush twice daily, clean your tongue, floss, rinse after meals and see a dentist.
lifestyle: Replace your brush every 3 months, stay hydrated and visit a dentist every 6 months.

name: Menstrual Cramps
causes: Uterine contractions, hormonal changes, sometimes endometriosis or fibroids.
avoid: Too much caffeine, salty food, smoking.
eat: Warm fluids, ginger tea, banana, leafy greens, nuts and plenty of water.
treat: Hot water bag on the lower belly, rest, light walking or yoga. See a doctor if pain is severe or bleeding is very heavy.
lifestyle: Exercise regularly, sleep well, reduce stress and track your cycle.

name: Motion Sickness
causes: A mismatch between eye and inner ear signals while travelling.
avoid: Reading or phone use in a moving vehicle, heavy or oily meals before travel.
eat: Light snacks, ginger candy, dry biscuits, water.
treat: Sit in the front seat, look at the horizon, get fresh air and close your eyes if needed.
lifestyle: Eat light before travel, choose seats with less motion and take breaks on long trips.

name: Sunburn
causes: Too much UV exposure without protection.
avoid: Midday sun (11 am–4 pm), peeling skin, tight clothing.
eat: Water, watermelon, cucumber, coconut water.
treat: Take a cool shower, apply aloe vera gel and wear loose cotton. See a doctor for blisters over a large area or fever.
medicine: Aloe vera gel or calamine lotion
lifestyle: Apply SPF 30+ sunscreen every 2–3 hours and cover up or wear a hat outdoors.

name: Minor Burns
causes: Hot water, steam, hot utensils or oil, sparks.
avoid: Ice directly on skin, butter, toothpaste, popping blisters.
eat: Water and protein-rich food to help healing.
treat: Hold under cool running water for 15–20 minutes and cover with a clean cloth. Go to a hospital for large, deep, face or genital burns.
medicine: Burn ointment (like silver sulfadiazine) on a pharmacist’s advice
lifestyle: Handle hot items carefully, turn pan handles inward and keep children away from the kitchen.

name: Minor Cuts & Wounds
causes: Sharp objects, falls and scrapes.
avoid: Touching the wound with dirty hands, leaving dirt in the wound.
eat: Protein, vitamin C and zinc rich food support healing.
treat: Wash with clean water and mild soap, press with a clean cloth to stop bleeding, apply antiseptic and cover. See a doctor for deep wounds, bleeding that won’t stop, or injury from a rusty object (tetanus shot).
lifestyle: Keep a first-aid kit at home and your tetanus vaccination up to date.

name: Insect Bites
causes: Mosquitoes, ants, bees, bed bugs and other insects.
avoid: Scratching the bite, strong perfumes that attract insects.
eat: Water; no special diet needed.
treat: Wash with soap, apply a cold compress and calamine lotion. Seek emergency help for breathing trouble or face swelling.
medicine: Calamine lotion (or Cetirizine 10 mg if very itchy)
lifestyle: Use mosquito nets or repellent, wear full sleeves at dusk and do not let water stand around.

name: Muscle Sprain
causes: Twisting or overstretching a joint or muscle during exercise, a fall or a sudden movement.
avoid: Walking on it, heat in the first 48 hours, massage right after injury.
eat: Protein, vitamin C, turmeric milk and plenty of water.
treat: RICE: Rest, Ice (15 minutes at a time), Compression bandage, Elevation. See a doctor if you can’t bear weight or swelling is severe.
lifestyle: Warm up before exercise, wear proper shoes and strengthen your muscles.

name: Dizziness
causes: Low blood pressure, dehydration, low blood sugar, anaemia, standing up suddenly, ear problems, anxiety.
avoid: Standing up quickly, skipping meals, dehydration, too much caffeine.
eat: Water, ORS, regular meals, iron-rich food, a salty snack if BP is low.
treat: Sit or lie down, drink fluids and rise slowly. See a doctor right away if dizziness comes with chest pain, weakness or trouble speaking.
medicine: ORS (no other medicine until the cause is found)
lifestyle: Eat on time, stay hydrated, get up slowly and check your BP and haemoglobin.

name: Anxiety
causes: Stress, overthinking, caffeine, lack of sleep, health or life worries, hormonal changes.
avoid: Too much caffeine, alcohol, late-night phone use, isolating yourself.
eat: Fruits, nuts, whole grains, omega-3 foods, chamomile or green tea.
treat: Slow deep breathing (inhale 4 seconds, exhale 6), grounding (name 5 things you see), walking and talking to someone. Seek professional help if it affects daily life.
medicine: None; medicines only through a doctor
lifestyle: Exercise, keep a routine, limit news and talk to friends, family or a counsellor.

name: Loss of Appetite
causes: Stress, illness, infection, medicines, low mood, constipation, heat.
avoid: Junk snacks before meals, poor sleep, drinking lots of fluids before eating.
eat: Small frequent meals, soups, fruits, nuts, lemon water, curd, ginger.
treat: Eat favourite healthy food, eat with family and take a light walk before meals. See a doctor if it lasts over 2 weeks or you lose weight.
lifestyle: Keep fixed meal times, make meals colourful and manage stress.

name: Overweight
causes: Excess calories, low activity, poor sleep, stress, genetics, hormonal issues (thyroid, PCOS).
avoid: Sugary drinks, junk and fried food, late-night eating, skipping breakfast.
eat: Vegetables, fruits, dal, sprouts, whole grains, curd and plenty of water.
treat: Eat smaller portions, walk 30–45 minutes daily and sleep 7–8 hours. Aim for slow loss and avoid crash diets; consult a doctor or dietitian.
medicine: None; no weight-loss pills without a doctor
lifestyle: Track your meals, move more through the day, sleep well and do not skip meals.

name: Cracked Heels
causes: Dry skin, standing long, open footwear, low moisture, fungal infection, diabetes.
avoid: Walking barefoot, hot water, harsh soaps.
eat: Water, healthy fats and vitamin E foods (nuts, seeds).
treat: Soak feet in lukewarm water for 10 minutes, scrub gently, then apply a thick foot cream and wear cotton socks. See a doctor if cracks are deep or bleeding.
lifestyle: Moisturise your feet nightly, wear closed shoes and keep feet clean and dry.

name: Blocked Nose
causes: Cold, allergy, sinus infection, dust, dry air.
avoid: Dust, smoke, cold drinks.
eat: Warm fluids, soup, ginger tea, tulsi.
treat: Steam inhalation, saline nasal rinse and sleeping with your head raised. See a doctor if it lasts over 10 days or there is facial pain.
lifestyle: Keep rooms clean, add moisture to dry air and avoid triggers like dust and smoke.

name: Chapped Lips
causes: Dry weather, dehydration, lip licking, sun, vitamin deficiency.
avoid: Licking lips, peeling the skin, harsh lip products.
eat: Water, vitamin B rich food and fruits.
treat: Apply lip balm often, keep lips moist and do not pick the skin.
medicine: Petroleum jelly or lip balm with SPF
lifestyle: Drink more water, protect lips from the sun and stop licking them.

name: Body Ache
causes: Viral infection, flu, fatigue, overexertion, dehydration, vitamin D deficiency.
avoid: Overexertion, dehydration, skipping rest.
eat: Warm soups, turmeric milk, fruits, water and protein.
treat: Rest, take a warm bath, stretch gently and drink fluids. See a doctor if it comes with high fever or lasts over a week.
lifestyle: Rest enough, get morning sunlight, stay hydrated and exercise lightly.

name: Burning Urination
causes: Urinary tract infection (UTI), dehydration, kidney stones, other infections, irritants.
avoid: Holding urine, caffeine, spicy food, sugary drinks.
eat: Plenty of water, coconut water, barley water and curd.
treat: Drink more water and see a doctor soon for a urine test, as UTIs usually need antibiotics. Seek urgent care for fever, back pain or blood in urine.
medicine: None; needs a doctor’s test and prescription
lifestyle: Drink enough water, urinate regularly, keep the area clean and wear cotton underwear.
